## I Housing Act 1996 Injunctions

## Scope of this Part

## 65.1 This Part contains rules –

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.1 This Part contains rules –] (a) in Section I, about injunctions under the Housing Act 1996 2 ;

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.1 This Part contains rules –] (b) in Section II, about applications by local authorities under section 91(3) of the Anti-social Behaviour Act 2003 3 for a power of arrest to be attached to an injunction;

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.1 This Part contains rules –] (c) in Section III, about claims for demotion orders under the Housing Acts 1985 and 1988, and for prohibited conduct standard contract orders under the Renting Homes (Wales) Act 2016, and related proceedings;

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.1 This Part contains rules –] (d) in Section IV, about anti-social behaviour orders under the Crime and Disorder Act 1998 6 ;

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.1 This Part contains rules –] (e) in Section V, about claims under section 3 of the Protection from Harassment Act 1997 7 ;

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.1 This Part contains rules –] (f) in Section VI, about applications for drinking banning orders and interim drinking banning orders under sections 4 and 9 of the Violent Crime Reduction Act 2006;

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.1 This Part contains rules –] (g) in Section VII, about parenting orders under sections 26A and 26B of the Anti-social Behaviour Act 2003 8 #f1007 ; and

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.1 This Part contains rules –] (h) in Section VIII, about injunctions under the Policing and Crime Act 2009. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.1 This Part contains rules –] Rules 65.2 to 65.7 omitted

## II APPLICATIONS BY LOCAL AUTHORITIES FOR POWER OF ARREST TO BE ATTACHED TO AN INJUNCTION

## Scope of this Section and interpretation

## 65.8

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.8] (1) This Section applies to applications by local authorities under section 91(3) of the Anti-social Behaviour Act 2003 11 or under section 27(3) of the Police and Justice Act 2006 12 for a power of arrest to be attached to an injunction. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.8] (Section 91 of the 2003 Act and section 27 of the 2006 Act apply to proceedings in which a local authority is a party by virtue of section 222 of the Local Government Act 1972 13 (power of local authority to bring, defend or appear in proceedings for the promotion or protection of the interests of inhabitants in their area)

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.8] (2) In this Section ‘the 2003 Act’ means the Anti-social Behaviour Act 2003. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.8] (3) In this Section ‘the 2006 Act’ means the Police and Justice Act 2006. ## 65.9

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.9] (1) An application under section 91(3) of the 2003 Act or section 27(3) of the 2006 Act for a power of arrest to be attached to any provision of an injunction must be made in the proceedings seeking the injunction by –

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.9] (a) the claim form;

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.9] (b) the acknowledgment of service;

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.9] (c) the defence or counterclaim in a Part 7 claim; or

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.9] (d) application under Part 23. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.9] (2) Every application must be supported by written evidence. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.9] (3) Every application made on notice must be served personally, together with a copy of the written evidence, by the local authority on the person against whom the injunction is sought not less than 2 days before the hearing. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.9] (Attention is drawn to rule 25.3(3) – applications without notice)

## Injunction containing provisions to which a power of arrest is attached

## 65.10

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.10] (1) Where a power of arrest is attached to a provision of an injunction on the application of a local authority under section 91(3) of the 2003 Act, the following rules in Section I of this Part shall apply –

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.10] (a) rule 65.4; and

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.10] (b) paragraphs (1), (2), (4) and (5) of rule 65.6. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.10] (1A) Where a power of arrest is attached to a provision of an injunction on the application of a local authority under section 27(3) of the 2006 Act, the following rules in Section I of this Part apply –

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.10] (a) rule 65.4;

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.10] (b) paragraphs (1), (2), (4) and (5) of rule 65.6;

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.10] (c) paragraph (1) of rule 65.7, as if the reference to paragraph 2(2)(b) of Schedule 15 to the Housing Act 1996 14 was a reference to paragraph 2(2)(b) of Schedule 10 to the 2006 Act; and

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.10] (d) paragraph (2) of rule 65.7. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.10] (2) CCR Order 29, rule 1 shall apply where an application is made in a county court to commit a person for breach of an injunction. ## Scope of this Section and interpretation

## 65.11

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.11] (1) This Section applies to –

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.11] (a) claims by a landlord for an order under section 82A of the Housing Act 1985 15 or under section 6A of the Housing Act 1988 16 (‘a demotion order’);

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.11] (aa) claims by a landlord for an order under section 121A of the Housing Act 1985 (‘a suspension order’);

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.11] (b) proceedings relating to a tenancy created by virtue of a demotion order;

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.11] (c) claims by a landlord for an order under section 116(4) of the Renting Homes (Wales) Act 2016. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.11] (2) In this Section –

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.11] (za) “the 2016 Act” means the Renting Homes (Wales) Act 2016;

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.11] (a) ‘a demotion claim’ means a claim made by a landlord for a demotion order;

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.11] (b) ‘a demoted tenancy’ means a tenancy created by virtue of a demotion order;

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.11] (ba) “a dwelling” means a dwelling let under an occupation contract;

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.11] (bb) “a prohibited conduct standard contract” has the meaning provided by section 116(6)(5) of the 2016 Act;

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.11] (bc) “a prohibited conduct standard contract order” is an order imposed under section 116(6) of the 2016 Act;

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.11] (bd) “a prohibited conduct standard contract order claim” means a claim for a prohibited conduct standard contract order;

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.11] (be) “a Renting Homes possession claim” means a claim for the recovery of possession of a dwelling under the 2016 Act. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.11] (c) ‘suspension claim’ means a claim made by a landlord for a suspension order; and

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.11] (d) ‘suspension period’ means the period during which the suspension order suspends the right to buy in relation to the dwelling house. ## 65.12

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.12] (1) Where a demotion order or suspension order (or both) is claimed in the alternative to a possession order, the claimant must use the Part 55 procedure and Section I of Part 55 applies, except that the claim must be made in the County Court in accordance with rule 55.3(1). [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.12] (2) Where a prohibited conduct standard contract order is claimed in the alternative to a possession order, the claimant must use the Part 55 procedure and Section IV of Part 55 applies. ## Other demotion claims, prohibited conduct standard contract order claims or suspension claims

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > Other demotion claims, prohibited conduct standard contract order claims or suspension claims] 65.13 Where a demotion claim or suspension claim (or both), or a prohibited conduct standard contract order claim is made other than in a possession claim or a Renting Homes possession claim, rules 65.14 to 65.19 apply. ## Starting a demotion claim, prohibited conduct standard contract order claim or suspension claim

## 65.14

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.14] (1)

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.14] (a) The claim may be made at any County Court hearing centre;

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.14] (b) the claim will be issued by the hearing centre where the claim is made; and

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.14] (c) if the claim is not made at the County Court hearing centre which serves the address where the property or dwelling is situated, the claim, when it is issued, will be sent to that hearing centre. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.14] (Practice Direction 65 makes further provision in respect of claims which are not made at the County Court hearing centre which serves the address where the property or dwelling is situated.)

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.14] (2) The claim form and form of defence sent with it must be in the forms set out in Practice Direction 65. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.14] (Part 16 and Practice Direction 65 provide details about the contents of the particulars of claim)

## Particulars of claim

## 65.15 The particulars of claim must be filed and served with the claim form. ## Hearing date

## 65.16

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.16] (1) The court will fix a date for the hearing when it issues the claim form. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.16] (2) The hearing date will be not less than 28 days from the date of issue of the claim form. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.16] (3) The standard period between the issue of the claim form and the hearing will be not more than 8 weeks. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.16] (4) The defendant must be served with the claim form and the particulars of claim not less than 21 days before the hearing date. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.16] (Rule 3.1(2)(a) provides that the court may extend or shorten the time for compliance with any rule and rule 3.1(2)(b) provides that the court may adjourn or bring forward a hearing)

## Defendant’s response

## 65.17

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.17] (1) An acknowledgement of service is not required and Part 10 does not apply. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.17] (2) Where the defendant does not file a defence within the time specified in rule 15.4 he may take part in any hearing but the court may take his failure to do so into account when deciding what order to make about costs. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.17] (3) Part 12 (default judgment) does not apply. ## The hearing

## 65.18

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.18] (1) At the hearing fixed in accordance with rule 65.16(1) or at any adjournment of that hearing the court shall take appropriate steps to ensure that the respondent is aware of their entitlement to a reasonable opportunity to obtain legal representation and to apply for legal aid which may be available without any means test, and may–

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.18] (a) decide the claim; or

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.18] (b) give case management directions. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.18] (2) Where the claim is genuinely disputed on grounds which appear to be substantial, case management directions given under paragraph (1)(b) will include the allocation of the claim to a track or directions to enable it to be allocated. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.18] (3) Except where –

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.18] (a) the claim is allocated to the fast track, intermediate track or the multi-track; or

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.18] (b) the court directs otherwise,

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.18] any fact that needs to be proved by the evidence of witnesses at a hearing referred to in paragraph (1) may be proved by evidence in writing. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.18] (Rule 32.2(1) sets out the general rule about evidence. Rule 32.2(2) provides that rule 32.2(1) is subject to any provision to the contrary)

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.18] (4) All witness statements must be filed and served at least two days before the hearing. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.18] (5) Where the claimant serves the claim form and particulars of claim, the claimant must produce at the hearing a certificate of service of those documents and rule 6.17(2)(a) does not apply. ## Allocation

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > Allocation] 65.19 When the court decides the track for the claim, the matters to which it shall have regard include –

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > Allocation] (a) the matters set out in rule 26.13; and

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > Allocation] (b) the nature and extent of the conduct alleged. ## Proceedings relating to demoted tenancies and prohibited conduct standard contract order claims

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > Proceedings relating to demoted tenancies and prohibited conduct standard contract order claims] 65.20 A practice direction may make provision about proceedings relating to demoted tenancies or to prohibited conduct standard contracts. ## IV ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR ORDERS MADE UNDER THE CRIME AND DISORDER ACT 1998

## Scope of this Section and interpretation

## 65.21

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.21] (1) This Section applies to applications in proceedings in the County Court under sub-sections (2), (3) or (3B) of section 1B of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998 17 by a relevant authority, and to applications for interim orders under section 1D of that Act. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.21] (2) In this Section –

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.21] (a) ‘the 1998 Act’ means the Crime and Disorder Act 1998;

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.21] (b) ‘relevant authority’ has the same meaning as in section 1(1A) of the 1998 Act; and

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.21] (c) ‘the principal proceedings’ means any proceedings in the County Court. ## Application where the relevant authority is a party in principal proceedings

## 65.22

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.22] (1) Subject to paragraph (2) –

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.22] (a) where the relevant authority is the claimant in the principal proceedings, an application under section 1B(2) of the 1998 Act for an order under section 1B(4) of the 1998 Act must be made in the claim form; and

[PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.22] (b) where the relevant authority is a defendant in the principal proceedings, an application for an order must be made by application notice which must be filed with the defence. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.22] (2) Where the relevant authority becomes aware of the circumstances that lead it to apply for an order after its claim is issued or its defence filed, the application must be made by application notice as soon as possible thereafter. [PART 65 – PROCEEDINGS RELATING TO ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR AND HARASSMENT > 65.22] (3) Where the application is made by application notice, it should normally be made on notice to the person against whom the order is sought.
